overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-24, accession 0001193125-26-067292), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities (in thousands): 'Additions to natural gas, NGLs and oil properties' $581,489 (FY2025) / $570,426 (FY2024) / $571,819 (FY2023) — tagged us-gaap PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment, a tag the engine does not read; 'Acreage purchases' $56,814 / $56,085 / $34,410; 'Additions to field service assets and other' $3,212 / $2,069 / $701. Total cash capex by year: FY2023 $606,930,000, FY2024 $628,580,000, FY2025 $641,515,000; the override value is the median of the three filed years (the FY2024 total).
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every candidate tag the engine reads: RRC's real E&P capex is filed as PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment (discontinued sibling PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProperty ends FY2018), which is not in the engine's tag list, and the only rollup tag it does read (PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment) ends at FY2018 with the minor field-service line ($1,477,000 in FY2018). The engine applies this single value to every missing period; it is the median of the filer's own FY2023-25 total cash capex (all three investing lines above). Against the true per-year totals it overstates FY2023 capex by $21,650,000 (conservative direction — lowers that year's OE), is exact for FY2024, and understates FY2025 capex by $12,935,000 (flatters the latest year by ~1.1% of FY2025 OCF — noted, not hidden). Excluded: purchases of marketable securities for the deferred compensation plan ($23,117,000 in FY2025) — a compensation-plan investment, not capex.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-24, accession 0001193125-26-067292), Consolidated Statements of Stockholders' Equity, line 'Stock-based compensation expense' (credited to additional paid-in capital; EDGAR tag AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationRequisiteServicePeriodRecognitionValue): $45,828,000 for FY2025, $42,072,000 for FY2024 and $36,427,000 for FY2023; the override value is the median of the three filed years (the FY2024 figure).
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under the engine's tags: AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense was last filed for FY2017 ($82,776,000) and ShareBasedCompensation ends in FY2013, so the expense survives only in the equity statement (the ALLY situation in this sweep). The cash-flow statement's combined 'Deferred and stock-based compensation' line ($67,849,000 / $53,864,000 / $48,153,000 for FY2023/24/25) is NOT used: it bundles cash-settled deferred compensation with equity SBC. The engine applies this single value to every missing period; against the true per-year equity-statement figures it overstates FY2023 SBC by $5,645,000 (conservative direction) and understates FY2025 SBC by $3,756,000 — both immaterial against OCF of ~$1B. Against the last engine-filed SBC value ($82,776,000, FY2017) the value is 0.51x, inside the 0.1x-10x band.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 2.09 vs 3-yr median 1.28 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.7x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base or a --base-judgment payable base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output / make_score's payable_5y impact
